    doc = doc_setup
    space = MentionNgrams(n_min=1, n_max=1)

    # Test with a list of str
    matcher = DictionaryMatch(d=["this"])
    assert set(tc.get_span() for tc in matcher.apply(space.apply(doc))) == {"This"}
